tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro snying thig las srog sgrub nag mo'i gtor dbang bzhugs so:

rigs kyi ḍākki yab yum lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: dpon slob bar chad mi 'byung phyir: da la sa chog grub pa yi: shan pa nag mo'i srog dbang bskur: de nas dpon slob thams cad kyis: mdun gyi nam mkha'i dkyil dag tu: 'od phung 'bar ba mtha' yas dkyil: bla ma yi dam ḍākki dam can tshogs: sprin phung bzhin du btibs par bsgoms pa'i mdun: shan pa nag mo 'khor bcas bskyed: rgyal ba rig 'dzin bsgom bzhin du: de ring las rnams sgrub par bsam: tshogs gtor mchod pa rgya chen 'bul: gtso bo bzhi yi gtor dbang bskur: bhyo: mkha' 'gro nag mo mi bsrun ma: sha za khrag mig srin po'i gdong : 'jigs pa'i gzugs can mkha' 'gro'i gtso: nag mo srid pa'i mtshon cha thogs: ba spu mtshon cha bskal pa'i me: rlung nag zhon nas ral pa sprug: srid pa'i shu lta mi lpags gyon: stong gsum sgrol byed zhal du snying dmar 'dzud: zhal nas khrag 'dzag kyu ru ru: spyan gsum khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs: ag tshom me 'bar 'tshub ma'i mtshon cha 'gyed: mi mgo'i do shal gsod byed rgya mtshos bskor: o rgyan bka' dang rig 'dzin bla ma'i bka': khyad par mkha' 'gro dam btags rjes 'breng la: dbang dang bka' lung bka' yi bstan pa bsrungs: o khyi kha le nag mos sod: srog ma tri sod: snying kha kha tham ya ya sod: rtsa ba bi ri mu sod: gha ya sod: nri ya sod: rag mo tsitta rbud: dam tshig ma bsrungs na chad pa chod cig: bsrungs na stong grogs mdzod cig /g.yas kyi gsod byed kyi gtor ma bzhag la: bhyo: sha za dmar mo ce spyang gdong : ro zhon snying khrag zhal du gsol: g.yas kyi sha za las mdzod cig / g.yon gyi gtor ma bzhag la: bhyo: nag mo wa gdong rngams pa'i gzugs: ba spu mtshon cha spu gris gtams: reg pas stong gsum sgrol byed ma: zhags pa spu gris glo mchin gcod: sha za khrag 'thung keng rus mur: bka' lung rjes 'brangs las mdzod cig: mdun gyi gtor ma bzhag la:

bhyo: mdun gyi srog gcod sha za mo: nag mo 'ug gdong gnam lcags sder: khrag ral mtshon stong dgra snying 'debs: gnam lcags mchu sder srog rtsa gcod: skad cig stong gsum nyul byed ma: rkan rdeb stong gsum snying khrag 'bru: stong gsum zas za srid gsum skom du 'thung : gsod byed lha mo 'khor bcas la: sha za khrag 'thung 'bum gyis bskor: dpon g.yog 'khor bcas las mdzod cig: dbang dang bka' lung gdams pa'i sgo phyes la: dam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bka' chad srungs: zhes dbang dang rjes gnang bya: rol mo sgrog: dus nyi shar ram: phyed yol: sa sros: nam phyed shis: de dus tshogs gtor bzang ba gal che'o: o rgyan bka' lung : ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal gdams: phyag len med thabs med pa rdzogs so: shan pa 'khor bcas bka'i bya ra mdzod la lung 'di khrol: 'di yi chos skyong kho la gtad do: rang bzo ma byed gnang bzhin mdzod: sa ma ya: zab rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: padma las 'brel rtsal gyi gter ma'o: : mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)mkha' 'gro snying thig las srog sgrub nag mo'i gtor dbang*/ - PAGE 178 -- PAGE 179 -- PAGE 177 -
